format_bounds.rationale: 1 MiB is a new-format-only input and parser ceiling: it is generous relative to Lockspire-generated values (43-byte secret, 35-byte client ID), limits decode/allocation work, and does not narrow legacy helper inputs. The total bound is derived exactly from the 1 MiB secret plus 6-byte version/length/age prefix, 16-byte migrated timestamp/deadline suffix, 12-byte IV, 16-byte GCM tag, unpadded Base64URL expansion, and maximum 32-byte key ID. Oversized existing legacy values are not normalized, truncated, or fallback-read; migration/activation reports blocked and leaves them unchanged.

maintenance_contract.selection: optional behavior implemented by the configured ClientStore module; selected explicitly and never defaulted to Repository
maintenance_contract.authority_return: {:ok, %{version: 1, transaction_authority: %{identity: term(), participants: map()}, participants: %{client_store: module(), transaction_store: module(), audit_store: module()}}} | {:error, :client_secret_verifier_maintenance_unsupported | :client_secret_verifier_maintenance_authority_mismatch}
maintenance_contract.authority_rule: participants must exactly match the selected client, transaction, and audit modules and equal the corresponding entries in selected TransactionStore.transaction_authority(). The full declared authority must exactly equal selected ClientStore.lifetime_contract().transaction_authority and selected TransactionStore.transaction_authority(); mismatch/absence fails before inventory or mutation
maintenance_contract.inventory_args: after_client_id is nil or canonical persisted client_id cursor; limit integer 1..500; caller default 100
maintenance_contract.inventory_order: ascending unsigned bytewise order of canonical client_id UTF-8 bytes; cursor exclusive and equals final returned ID; pages at most limit; terminal page has next_cursor nil and complete? true; nonterminal page is nonempty and next_cursor equals last ID; empty inventory is [], nil, true
maintenance_contract.inventory_scope: every persisted client regardless of auth method, active/lifecycle state, expiry, verifier presence, or validity; no filtering; duplicate IDs, malformed/unreadable rows, invalid cursor, or uninspected remainder block readiness
maintenance_contract.inventory_consistency: one bounded query/page at a time; traversal is not a database snapshot, quiescence, or fleet-parity proof; concurrent changes may make a run incomplete/uncertain and require a fresh complete scan after caller-owned quiescence
maintenance_contract.rewrap_args: expected/replacement material compared byte-for-byte; audit_attrs allowlisted and contains no secret/hash/verifier/ciphertext; client_id required
maintenance_contract.rewrap_atomicity: caller invokes compare_and_rewrap inside an already-open transaction owned by selected TransactionStore; callback locks and reloads current row, if current verifier already equals replacement and expected hash matches return provisional already_current without audit, otherwise compare expected hash and verifier, replace only verifier ciphertext, append one allowlisted audit event in same outer transaction; :changed is provisional until outer commit and command reports changed only after commit; audit failure rolls back update; never use direct Repository fallback
maintenance_contract.rewrap_preserves: client_secret_hash, client_id, active, metadata, management fields, app/secret lifetimes, rotation timestamps, inserted_at, updated_at, and every field other than verifier ciphertext; audit event carries maintenance time
maintenance_contract.status: contract-only; behavior and adapter composition evidence pending Phase 177/178
